title: Pixel inventory: tabbed paper panels on a dithered Prussian-blue ground, a 6 x 5 slot grid with rarity by frame colour and gem count, a detail panel and actions
use: An RPG inventory screen on the 480 x 270 grid: tabs, a slot grid (filled, empty and locked slots), the selected item's detail, three actions and a load / gold footer.

selected.note: selected slot (shown in the detail panel)

capacity.note: usable slots; the rest are locked

load.note: carried weight on the load bar (of 30)

default: 旧船上拆下来的罗盘，指针不指北，
总是指向离你最近的一盏灯。

key_hint.default: Z 装备  X 返回

relations: Rarity never by colour alone: frame colour plus 0-4 gem pips (common, fine, rare, epic, legendary).
Every panel is paper with its dark-red plate 2 px down-right; the selected tab and action are pale with vermilion lines.
Counts are 3 x 5 bitmap digits outlined in ink inside the slot; gold only on graphics, never as text on paper (1.6:1).
decoration: Dithered ground, slot frames and gems, item icons (the case's sixteen drawn 16 x 16 icons as placeholders), locks, the load bar, coin.

provenance.corpus: pixel-rpg-ui case round 2 (白垩驿路 CHALKROAD): our own original fictional pixel RPG in the woodblock-pixel grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/woodblock-pixel/style.json provenance; case renders in docs/cases/pixel-rpg-ui
provenance.method: Ported from the case's screens.cjs inventory: grid origin 18,50, pitch 26, the case's seventeen items as placeholders; counts, tabs and selection became parameters.
measured: Round 2 first pass: two green effect lines on paper 2.2:1; final 0 (pine green on paper).
Text all 12 px or 24 px native, checked at the native 480 x 270 (12 px counts as body text: 4.5:1).
